title_en: Online stochastic gradient descent on non-convex losses from high-dimensional inference
title_zh: 高维推断非凸损失上的在线随机梯度下降

verified_metadata.title: Online stochastic gradient descent on non-convex losses from high-dimensional inference
verified_metadata.abstract: The first nonzero derivative of the population loss at zero overlap defines an information exponent that sets polynomial sample thresholds for online SGD from random initialization.
verified_metadata.comment: Final JMLR article; corresponding preprint arXiv:2003.10409

sections.title: 作者信息
paragraphs: 作者 Gerard Ben Arous、Reza Gheissari、Aukosh Jagannath；Journal of Machine Learning Research 22(106), 1–51 (2021)，对应 arXiv:2003.10409。核验JMLR最终全文51页；期刊页面未列DOI。

sections.title: 研究问题
paragraphs: 在high-dimensional teacher-student inference中，online SGD从随机起点优化random non-convex sample losses。需要多少独立samples才能与ground truth形成非平凡overlap并最终consistent？是否存在不依赖全局convexity或uniform derivative control的统一complexity参数？

sections.title: 背景
paragraphs: 参数约束在N维sphere，teacher θN固定，population risk只通过overlap m=θ·θN/N变化。作者把m=0附近population drift首个非零阶定义为information exponent k：k越高，随机起点的signal越弱，初始search越困难。
online设定每步使用一个新sample且不复用；结论描述高维渐近、rotationally invariant data和指定step-size scaling，不等价于finite dataset的multi-epoch minibatch SGD。

sections.title: 模型与方法
paragraphs: 作者将projected SGD的overlap过程分成search、descent和local convergence三个阶段，以martingale concentration控制sample noise，并对time-rescaled dynamics建立law-of-large-numbers limit。上/下界给一致估计所需M随dimension N的多项式阈值，其指数由k决定。
应用覆盖phase retrieval、generalized linear models、online PCA、spiked tensor inference及单神经元supervised learning。对Hermite activation，information exponent由与teacher signal相关的首个非零Hermite coefficient决定。

sections.title: 核心结果与证据
paragraphs: 主定理表明k=1任务近线性samples即可启动，k=2出现N log N尺度，k≥3需要约N^{k-1}量级（精确上下界含小指数/对数条件）；大多数samples消耗在从随机overlap O(N^{-1/2})逃离无信息区域。
一旦达到固定正overlap，descent阶段在较少额外samples内遵循确定性population flow，局部阶段再收敛到teacher。这种两时间尺度解释为何warm start显著降低难度。
Figure 2.1比较activation x²与x³−3x：随机起点前者平滑进入高overlap，后者长期停留后陡升，且sample/time尺度大得多；Figure 2.2 warm start使两者都快速下降，Figure 2.3展示不同initialization和step-size trajectories。

sections.title: 有效性与局限
paragraphs: 结果依赖单index/低秩teacher结构、sphere constraint、fresh independent samples及regularity/moment assumptions。information exponent只描述m≈0局部signal，若population loss有额外bad attractors、anisotropy或model mismatch，单一k不能概括全部动力学。
渐近阈值并非精确finite-N sample recommendation，图中每条件只有少量runs。现代deep networks、minibatch、momentum/Adam、data reuse与representation learning均不在定理范围。

sections.title: 复现与资源
paragraphs: 全文：https://www.jmlr.org/papers/v22/20-1288.html；预印本：https://arxiv.org/abs/2003.10409。JMLR PDF SHA-256：713b2af1c17706a24a21f7316000a114b8870569983c76e881b40e7cb095eab9。正文未给代码仓库。

复现Figure 2需固定N=3000、sample counts α、activation/Hermite polynomial、random/warm starts、sphere projection、step-size schedule和four-run seeds。Evidence status: full-text verified theoretical/numerical study; no independent reproduction performed.

sections.title: 阅读指南
paragraphs: 先读 pp.1–6 model与information exponent；pp.7–12看三个学习阶段和sample thresholds；pp.13–16读Figures 2.1–2.3；pp.17–31看applications；pp.32–51为proofs。
